purpose: To present an appeal to the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal in Form NCLAT-1.
who: The appellant or petitioner or applicant or respondent, as the case may be, in person or by his duly authorised representative
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the appeal in Form NCLAT-1 in triplicate.
Attach a certified copy of the impugned order.
Prepare an index in triplicate containing document details and fee paid.
Prepare sufficient copies of the appeal for service on the opposite party.
Include the required processing fee, envelopes, and notice forms.
Present the appeal at the filing counter in person or by a duly authorised representative.
checklist: Certified copy of the impugned order
Index in triplicate with document details and fee paid
Sufficient number of copies of the appeal for service on the opposite party
Processing fee with required number of envelopes of sufficient size and notice forms
attachments: Certified copy of the impugned order
Processing fee, envelopes, and notice forms
watch: Non-compliance with presentation rules may constitute a valid ground to refuse to entertain the appeal.
